class.name: FmodFile
class.brief_description: A sound file loaded by FMOD's Core API.
class.description: Returned by [method FmodServer.load_file_as_sound] and [method FmodServer.load_file_as_music]. Play it with [method create_instance]. The file is unloaded once nothing references it any more, neither a script nor an [FmodSound] created from it. Release every file and its sounds before [method FmodServer.shutdown].

method.name: create_instance
method.description: Creates a paused instance of this file. Call [method FmodSound.play] to start it.
